NOCTURNAL_CURFEW.name: Municipal Nocturnal Street Curfew
NOCTURNAL_CURFEW.description: Citizens must remain within indoor domestic quarters between 22:00 and 05:00 unless holding watchman or emergency labor vouchers.

BREAD_PRICE_CEILING.name: Hearth Bread Price Ceiling & Anti-Usury Cap
BREAD_PRICE_CEILING.description: Caps the retail market price of bread loaves at 1.0g to safeguard indigent citizens against commercial gouging.

SUMPTUARY_SPENDING_CAP.name: Sumptuary Wealth & Ostentation Cap
SUMPTUARY_SPENDING_CAP.description: Levies surcharges on luxury purchases and restrains ostentatious displays of hoarded wealth.

INFRASTRUCTURE_REPAIR_MANDATE.name: Emergency Public Works & Infrastructure Repair Mandate
INFRASTRUCTURE_REPAIR_MANDATE.description: Allocates municipal treasury funds to sponsor emergency timber bracing, masonry repairs, and road clearing.
